# OpenTelemetry instrumentation factory

The local factory and its type declarations are adapted from @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node 0.81.0 (Apache-2.0). Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors. Only the unused cloud-resource-detector imports and export were removed. All instrumentation implementations, order, explicit configuration and environment-variable selection remain unchanged. Dependencies are pinned to the previously verified installed versions. The existing NodeSDK resource detection is unchanged.
